bcc.description: Email addresses to blind-copy on the email (hidden recipients).

cc.description: Email addresses to copy on the email (carbon copy recipients).

from.description: The sender email address, optionally in 'Name <email@example.com>' format.

html.description: The HTML body of the email.

reply_to.description: The email address replies to this email should be sent to.

subject.description: The subject line of the email.

text.description: The plain-text body of the email.

to.description: The recipient email addresses to send the email to.
